text: Good morning, traders. Monday, April twenty-seventh, European pre-market, and US futures are green. Tech is carrying the tape: Nasdaq up just over one percent, semis hot for an eighteenth straight day. Intel is up twenty-three percent, AMD up fourteen, and S and P futures are pressing toward seven thousand one hundred sixty-five. Crypto is holding: Bitcoin near seventy-eight thousand, Ethereum still choppy. But under the rally, the risk is war and oil. In the Middle East, conflict has cut supply by ten million barrels a day, keeping crude near one hundred dollars. Sentiment is cracking too, down to forty-nine point eight, the weakest since nineteen fifty-two. The Fed meets this week, with ninety-nine percent odds of no change. Playbook: bulls bet on the pause, semis lead, oil-sensitive names lag, and Wednesday's print can reset the trade. That's your daily market pulse. See you tomorrow.
